# CLAUDE.md

## Attribution for generated files

- **Commit trailer:** only commits that add a file Claude generated from scratch get a trailer, and it is `Generated-by: Claude Opus 5.5` (not `Co-Authored-By`). Edits, moves, renames and fixes to existing files get no trailer.
- **Header comment:** every file Claude generates from scratch starts with a one-line comment in the file's own syntax, e.g. `// Generated by Claude (Opus 5.5), YYYY-MM-DD`. Use `#` for shell/Python and `<!-- -->` for HTML/Markdown. In scripts, put it on the line after the shebang.
- This applies to new files only; existing files are not labelled retroactively.
- Commit generated files separately from hand edits so the trailer stays accurate.
